findings.evidence: commands/evals/ contains only explain-pr-changes.json and files/; there is no commands/evals/viral-tweet.json
findings.fix: Add commands/evals/viral-tweet.json with 3 or more realistic prompts: a casual idea, a precise product-launch idea, and an edge case such as an empty argument, a very long idea, or an idea that is already a thread. Give each an expected output and verifiable assertions, such as 'output has ORIGINAL, ANALYSIS, 3 OPTIMIZED VERSIONS, RECOMMENDED and POSTING STRATEGY sections' and 'no version has hashtags or links'.

findings.evidence: "The For You feed is powered by a Grok-based transformer that predicts engagement probabilities... Final Score = Σ (weight × P(action))"; the 'Hook Engineering', 'Emotional Resonance' and 'Repost Psychology' sections list generic copywriting advice (curiosity gap, specificity, high-arousal emotions)
findings.fix: Cut the generic growth-marketing lists that the model already knows. Keep only the non-obvious knowledge: concrete weights or ordering of signals if they are verified, and X-specific penalties. Compress the P(action) lists into one line.

findings.evidence: "Never trigger: Spam patterns... Engagement bait... Rage bait... Cringe" with no reasons or concrete examples
findings.fix: Replace the list with specific NEVER items that each give a reason. For example, 'NEVER put a link in the main tweet because X suppresses external links; put it in the first reply', and 'NEVER fabricate stats or backstory in the rewrite, because the author has to stand behind it'.

findings.evidence: "If no argument provided, ask the user for their tweet idea or topic." There is no handling for the 280-character limit, a long input that is really a thread, or an idea that is sensitive or unsafe to optimize. There is no check step before output.
findings.fix: State the character limit (280, or longer if the account is premium) and require each version to fit it. Add a self-check list before output: no hashtags or links, within length, still in the author's voice, and no invented facts. Say what to do when the idea is a thread or controversial.

findings.evidence: description: Transform a raw tweet idea into an optimized viral post for X
findings.fix: Rewrite as: 'Rewrite a raw tweet idea or draft into three optimized X (Twitter) posts (hook, reply and repost variants) with analysis, a recommended pick and a posting strategy. Use when the user wants a tweet, post, thread idea or X copy made more engaging or viral.'

findings.evidence: The Output Format fixes three variants (hook, reply, repost) plus a long analysis and posting strategy for every input, even a one-line idea. The 'Style Guidelines' list is terse and unreasoned.
findings.fix: Make the long analysis and posting-strategy blocks optional or brief for simple inputs. Give a short reason for each style rule, and keep the exact template only for the section headings.
